items.desktop: Expects {"themes":[...]} array for both GET /themes and POST /themes/refresh
items.core: Both routes return exactly {"themes":[row,...]}, bundled+library+drawer order

items.desktop: parseThemeTokens accepts flat light:{...} or nested light:{colors:{...}} defensively
items.core: Doc specifies flat token map: light:{...}, dark:{...}, type, radius, motion, sounds

items.desktop: Any 404 on GET install-job maps to status 'none', ignoring error text
items.core: 404 'no download for this pack' when no job; also 404 for unknown/bundled id

items.desktop: Treats PUT /theme 409 as 'Finish Get started first', body text unchecked
items.core: 409 {"error":"no profile yet"} fires only when profile.yaml doesn't exist yet

items.desktop: useThemeSync expects theme.changed pushed on the same WS /chat it listens to
items.core: Sends {"type":"theme.changed","id"} on WS /chat, mirroring avatar.changed exactly

other: connectChatSocket's ChatEvent allowlist omits 'theme.changed'; frame is parsed then silently discarded, never reaching onEvent
useThemeSync's follow() callback is defined but not invoked from any socket handler in scope
GET /themes/:id/tokens 409 tampered-cache case falls into generic 'error', losing the specific 'download again' reason
PUT /theme 400 malformed-id case is unreachable in practice since desktop only sends regex-validated known row ids
